questions.q: An editor calls a one-day service pilot encouraging, but says its results do not justify a claim that the service will work everywhere. What is the editor's stance?
o: The universal claim is already firmly established.
The pilot showed that the service has no value.
The editor questions the reach of the conclusion.
The editor declines to evaluate the pilot at all.

exp.trans: 编辑肯定一天试点有希望，却认为不能用它证明服务处处有效。
exp.structure: encouraging是积极的局部评价；but后限定了结论适用范围。
exp.other: pilot试点；universal普遍适用；justify证明合理。
exp.meaning: 对证据推论范围的质疑不等于否认试点价值，也不等于作者没有态度。
exp.rest: 完全证实、毫无价值以及拒绝评价都违背了文章的限定性表述。

questions.q: The frightened child ___ tightly to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / climbed
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，受惊的孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The frightened child + clung tightly to + his father's arm，tightly修饰clung。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: frightened 害怕的；tightly 紧紧地；lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed tightly to his father's arm不符合“紧抓手臂”的语义和搭配；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed / climb的第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

questions.q: The curator says visitor numbers may rise under a new entry policy, but the projected increase comes from untested assumptions. What is her attitude to the projection?
o: She fully accepts the predicted attendance growth.
She questions whether the forecast is reliable.
She has no view on the policy's ticket prices.
She denies any possible rise in museum visits.

exp.trans: 馆长认为游客可能增加，但增长预测依赖未经验证的假设。
exp.structure: but连接对增长可能性的承认与对预测可靠性的保留。
exp.other: curator馆长；projection预测；assumption假设。
exp.meaning: skepticism是对特定论断的证据提出质疑，不等于全面否认增长可能。
exp.rest: 完全接受预测、无关的票价态度和完全否认增长都没有保留作者质疑的对象。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
questions.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

questions.q: During a field inspection, a technician fastened a thin cord around the sensor housing by making a knot. The team then handed a calibration weight from one person to the next. Which pair describes the actions?
o: wrapped the cord / carried the weight
tied the cord / passed the weight
passed the cord / tied the weight
lit the cord / wrapped the weight

exp.trans: 现场检查时，技术员打结把细绳系在传感器外壳上；随后团队成员把校准砝码从一人手中传到下一人手中。对应动作是tie和pass。
exp.structure: 第一句technician fastened...by making a knot，by短语明确系绳方式是打结；第二句the team handed...from one person to the next，明确物体在人与人之间转交。
exp.other: field inspection现场检查；sensor housing传感器外壳；calibration weight校准砝码；knot结。
exp.meaning: tie表示系住、打结；pass something from one person to the next表示把东西传递给下一个人。要识别动作的结果和路径。
exp.rest: wrap表示包裹或缠绕，未必形成固定的结；carry表示携带而非交到下一人手中；pass the cord / tie the weight把两个动作对象对调；light和wrap都不符合句中动作。

questions.skill: 排除性证据与因果边界
questions.q: Bird counts rose after riverfront lights were dimmed. Some argued that fewer boats explained the increase, but traffic records showed no decline in boats. What does this evidence do?
o: It demonstrates that lighting was the only possible cause.
It weakens the alternative explanation based on boat traffic.
It establishes that birds were never affected by boat noise.
It shows that the original bird counts were fabricated.

exp.trans: 调暗河岸灯光后鸟类增加；有人认为是船只减少所致，但记录显示船只没有减少。
exp.structure: some argued提出竞争性解释；but引出相反证据。
exp.other: traffic record流量记录；alternative explanation替代解释。
exp.meaning: 船只未减少削弱了船只减少造成增长的解释，但不能单凭此证明灯光是唯一原因。
exp.rest: 不能据此排除所有其他因素、证明船噪从无影响，或判定统计造假。

questions.q: After an appeal, a referee reduced a player's suspension from six matches to two, but kept the penalty. The revised sanction is best described as:
o: more lasting because it follows a formal hearing
more severe because it still includes a penalty
more lenient, although punishment still remains
less certain because the referee did not decide

exp.trans: 申诉后停赛从六场减为两场，但处罚并未取消。
exp.structure: reduced...from...to...表达数量下降；but kept the penalty限定处罚仍在。
exp.other: lenient宽大的；severe严厉的；suspension停赛。
exp.meaning: 更宽大等价于处罚程度更轻，不等于完全免罚。
exp.rest: 延长、加重或裁判尚未决定均与已经明确减轻处罚相反。

tone.q: After several weeks of physiotherapy, the patient regained enough muscle tone to stand without assistance. Here, muscle tone refers to:
o: 说话语气
肌肉张力
肤色
音高

exp.trans: 经过几周的物理治疗后，患者恢复了足够的肌张力，可以在无人帮助的情况下站立。
exp.structure: 主干：the patient（主语）+ regained（谓语）+ enough muscle tone（宾语）。to stand without assistance表示恢复到足以站立的结果/程度。
exp.other: physiotherapy 物理治疗；regain 恢复；assistance 帮助；stand 站立。
exp.meaning: muscle tone是固定医学表达，指肌张力。
exp.rest: tone可表示语气、色调、音调，但muscle明确限定了词义；说话语气常见tone of voice，肤色常见skin tone，音高通常是pitch。

tone.q: A restaurant's award makes visitors assume every dish must be excellent. A reviewer then describes a poorly prepared meal. What problem does the review illustrate?
o: A positive first impression may bias later ratings.
Awards guarantee the quality of every dish served.
One bad meal proves that the prize was awarded illegally.
Reviewers can never be affected by restaurant fame.

exp.trans: 餐馆获奖让顾客假设所有菜都好，但评论者发现一餐质量差。
exp.structure: makes visitors assume解释光环判断；then introduces反例。
exp.other: halo effect光环效应；bias使产生偏见；rating评价。
exp.meaning: 单一良好印象可能不当地扩展为对所有其他方面的肯定。
exp.rest: 奖项无法保证每道菜品质，糟糕的一餐也不能证明奖项违法，更不能推断评论者完全免疫声誉影响。

tone.target: even if premise vs total endorsement
tone.q: A columnist says: Even if working from home saves travel time, it does not follow that every team performs better remotely. What does the opening concession do?
o: It confirms that remote work improves every team.
It establishes that commuting savings are untrue.
It changes the discussion to transport policy alone.
It grants one premise without accepting the conclusion.

exp.trans: 评论者暂且承认远程办公节约通勤时间，却不接受所有团队表现更好的结论。
exp.structure: even if引导让步，does not follow拒绝从前提直接推出普遍结论。
exp.other: premise前提；concession让步；remotely远程地。
exp.meaning: 让步从句可以暂时接受某前提，却对扩大化结论保持怀疑。
exp.rest: 完全支持、否认节约通勤和转移主题都不是让步结构的真实作用。

cling-climb.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 攀爬
固守
批评
修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: 攀爬对应climb，不是cling to规则的比喻；批评和修改是对规则采取改变的态度，语境却说仍不愿放弃旧规则。

author-stance.target: 事实描述 / 作者价值判断
author-stance.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
author-stance.q: A report says that residents posted hundreds of angry comments after the council announced a parking plan. Which conclusion is directly supported?
o: The report endorses the angry comments as a fair response.
Residents posted many angry comments after the announcement.
The council designed the plan knowing it would harm residents.
The comments show that opposition extended to every resident.

exp.trans: 一份报告说，市议会公布停车方案后，居民发布了数百条愤怒评论。原文直接支持：居民在公告后发布了大量愤怒评论；after只说明先后，不能据此确定因果。
exp.structure: 主句：A report（主语）+ says（谓语）+ that宾语从句。that从句：residents（主语）+ posted（谓语）+ hundreds of angry comments（宾语）；after从句只交代时间。句子报告发生了什么，没有评价这些评论是否应得。
exp.other: council 市议会；announce 公布；substantial 大量的/显著的；reaction 反应。
exp.meaning: 负面评论的存在不等于作者认为批评对象活该。after只报告时间先后；要断言公告引发评论，还需要明确的因果证据。
exp.rest: 报告评论数量不等于赞同评论；设计有害方案的动机没有证据；数百条评论不能扩大为每一位居民的立场。

author-stance.target: 引述立场 / 作者限定评价
author-stance.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
author-stance.q: An association calls volunteers “unreliable.” The author notes that missed visits often follow last-minute roster changes. “Better coordination,” she writes, “would be more useful than another lecture about commitment.” Which view belongs to the author?
o: She accepts the association’s description as an explanation for the missed visits.
She regards missed visits as evidence that volunteers want to leave.
She favours improving coordination over simply blaming commitment.
She considers punctuality irrelevant to the association’s work.

exp.trans: 某协会把志愿者称为“不可靠”。作者指出，缺席往往发生在排班临时变动之后。她写道：“更好的协调，比再说教一遍奉献精神更有用。”作者倾向改善协调，而不是简单归咎于态度。
exp.structure: An association + calls + volunteers + unreliable属于引述他人评价。The author + notes + that从句另给解释线索；would be more useful than是作者自己的比较判断，she writes确定说话者。
exp.other: association 协会；roster 排班表；last-minute 临时的；commitment 投入、责任心。
exp.meaning: 先分清谁在评价，再追踪作者自己的证据和限定比较。这里没有deserve或all，也不能把文章引用的标签直接记到作者名下。
exp.rest: accepts the description把协会标签当作者解释，忽略作者提供的排班因素；want to leave补出离开的动机；punctuality irrelevant把“协调更有用”扩大成准时无关，比较优先级不等于否认准时的重要性。

author-stance.q: An editorial says: "Opening the reading room on Sundays deserves a trial. The report offered to justify it, however, omits staff costs and cannot establish that the plan is affordable." How does the editorial assess the report?
o: It is inadequate as a case for the proposal.
It convincingly establishes the project's value.
It merely lists facts without supporting a view.
It gives a fair account of all financial effects.

exp.trans: 社论认为周日开放阅览室值得试行；但作为论据的报告漏计人力成本，无法证明方案负担得起。对报告的判断是论证不足。
exp.structure: Opening...是首句主语；第二句The report是主语，omits与cannot establish是并列谓语。however把值得尝试的方案与不足以支撑它的报告区分开。
exp.other: editorial 社论；justify 为……提供理由；omit 漏计；affordable 负担得起的。
exp.meaning: 问评价时先确定对象。对方案的局部肯定不能代替对报告证据质量的否定评价。
exp.rest: “有力证明项目价值”与cannot establish相反；报告被用来论证方案，不能说不支持任何观点；漏计人力成本使其并未完整涵盖财务影响。

author-stance.target: oppose process vs oppose all projects
author-stance.skill: 反对方式不等于反对建设
author-stance.q: A columnist says the city needs more clinics, but criticizes plans to build them without checking transport links or population needs. What is the columnist's position?
o: Every clinic proposal must be permanently rejected.
The clinics are needed, but their sites require scrutiny.
Residents should abandon all plans to expand care.
Transport capacity should never influence clinic sites.

exp.trans: 作者认可诊所需求，却批评不考虑交通与人口需求的选址。
exp.structure: needs more clinics肯定目标；but criticizes限定批评的方式。
exp.other: scrutiny审慎评估；transport links交通连接。
exp.meaning: 反对未经评估的选址不等于反对建设本身。
exp.rest: 全面否决、放弃扩建和无视交通都不符合作者立场。

author-stance.q: An editorial welcomes new electricity lines where grid demand is high, but warns against allowing contractors to cut through protected habitats without review. Which position is most faithful?
o: Electricity networks should never expand anywhere.
Protected habitats should be opened to any contractor.
Expansion is acceptable when routes are carefully reviewed.
New electricity lines are unnecessary in busy regions.

exp.trans: 社论欢迎在需求高处增设电线，却反对未经审查穿越保护区。
exp.structure: welcomes...where...限制支持范围；but warns against说明反对对象。
exp.other: grid电网；contractor承包商；habitat栖息地。
exp.meaning: 可以支持有规划的扩建，同时反对任意侵占。
exp.rest: 完全禁止扩建、允许随意穿越和否认需求都偏离作者立场。

author-stance.skill: 明确反对对象与替代方案
author-stance.q: A planner argues that housing is necessary, yet proposes reusing vacant city lots before converting farmland. She criticizes unchecked edge-of-town building. What is her main objection?
o: She objects to every form of new housing.
She believes vacant city lots should stay unused.
She opposes protecting farmland near urban areas.
She objects to poorly sited growth, not all housing.

exp.trans: 规划师承认住房需求，优先用城市空地，反对无控制的郊外扩建。
exp.structure: housing is necessary肯定目标；yet提出选址优先顺序。
exp.other: vacant lot闲置地；farmland农田；unchecked未经控制的。
exp.meaning: 反对不合理选址不等于反对住房供给。
exp.rest: 完全禁止、让城市空地闲置和反对保护农田都与原文相反。

author-stance.skill: 有方向的质疑与全面否定
author-stance.q: An engineer says automatic translation always preserves humor. A writer notes several failures while acknowledging that many translations are useful. Which response best fits the writer?
o: She treats the guarantee as true in every case.
She refuses to consider translation technology.
She cannot identify the engineer's central claim.
She doubts the guarantee, not every translation.

exp.trans: 工程师声称机器翻译始终保留幽默，作者列出反例但承认不少翻译有用。
exp.structure: always是绝对化主张；while acknowledging限定反对范围。
exp.other: guarantee保证；preserve保留；acknowledge承认。
exp.meaning: 作者质疑的是always的无条件保证，不是否认技术一切价值。
exp.rest: 全面赞同、拒绝讨论技术和无法辨认主张均不符合反例及保留性肯定。

author-stance.q: A technician writes: We cannot yet tell whether the sensor failed or its batteries died; neither explanation has been tested. What attitude does this express?
o: Uncertainty because the cause remains untested.
Skepticism about the maker's basic honesty.
Approval of the sensor's current performance.
Rejection of both possible failure mechanisms.

exp.trans: 技术员尚无法判断传感器失效还是电池耗尽，两种原因都未验证。
exp.structure: cannot yet tell表明未有足够证据作出判断；neither...has been tested说明原因。
exp.other: sensor传感器；mechanism机理；battery电池。
exp.meaning: 这里没有批驳某个确定论点，只是对原因尚无定论，属于uncertainty。
exp.rest: 质疑制造商诚信、赞同表现及排除两种原因都超出文本。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It measures a shift in members' views on conservation.
It shows why government funds were needed for the trial.
It explains how the new system reduced water consumption.
It illustrates how local groups can help launch a policy.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 没有成员前后态度的测量，不能证明观点转变；材料没有交代政府资金；也没有比较节水系统的技术效果。合作社组织志愿者和动员试用，支持的是政策启动机制。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: The bonus increased hazards along with reports of near-misses.
Official incident totals are more reliable than the survey.
Anonymity motivated workers more than the safety bonus did.
Reporting changes can raise counts without raising hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 调查显示危险发生频率未变，不能断言奖励增加危险；材料没有给两种数据排可靠性名次；匿名是调查方式，不能据此比较匿名与奖金的激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
example-claim-scope.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。

action-collocation.skill: 包裹与打结的动作区别
action-collocation.q: Before shipping a glass instrument, a clerk covered it with protective cloth, folding the cloth around the case in several layers. No knot or fastening was used. Which paraphrase best describes the action?
o: wrapped the case in protective cloth
tied the cloth tightly around the case
passed the cloth to a colleague nearby
lit the cloth with a match

exp.trans: 发运玻璃仪器前，工作人员用防护布包住仪器，把布一层层折叠在外壳周围；没有打结或固定。动作是包裹。
exp.structure: a clerk covered it...是主干；folding the cloth around the case补充包裹方式；No knot or fastening was used排除了打结固定。
exp.other: protective cloth防护布；case外壳；layer层；fastening固定件/固定动作。
exp.meaning: wrap强调用材料包住或缠绕物体；tie强调用绳带系住，常包含打结或固定。此处布料覆盖并折叠，没有系结。
exp.rest: tie要求系住/固定的动作，题干明确说没有knot或fastening；pass表示传递；light表示点燃，均不符合包裹仪器的场景。

action-collocation.q: At a camp safety drill, one camper handed a lantern from the first person to the last; another lit a stove after the group had settled. Which pair describes the actions?
o: lit the lantern / passed the stove
passed the lantern / lit the stove
wrapped the lantern / tied the stove
tied the lantern / wrapped the stove

exp.trans: 营地安全演练中，一名露营者把灯笼从队伍第一个人传到最后一个人；另一人等大家安顿后点燃了炉子。动作分别是传递灯笼和点燃炉子。
exp.structure: one camper handed a lantern...是第一项动作；from the first person to the last给出传递路径。another lit a stove是第二项动作，after从句说明时间。
exp.other: camp safety drill营地安全演练；lantern灯笼；stove炉子；settle安顿下来。
exp.meaning: pass表示把物品从一个人交给另一个人；light表示点燃。要把动词与其实际宾语及动作路径配对。
exp.rest: 把lit和passed的对象对调；wrap和tie表示包裹/系绑，不符合手递手传灯笼或点燃炉子的动作。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: Healthier seedlings prompted the gardeners to provide shade.
The gardeners' shade reduced heat exposure for the seedlings.
The seedlings sheltered the gardeners from the hottest sun.
The drying seedlings caused a fall in the surrounding heat.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: 把幼苗更健康当成遮阳的先前原因是因果倒置；幼苗保护园丁交换了施事与受益者；干枯导致环境降温既反转因果，又偷换了暴露量与环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension caused firms to miss the earlier deadline.
Measured gains in later participation prompted the council's extension.
Missed deadlines prompted an extension; later effects are unmeasured.
The earlier deadline was a response to the council's later extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: 后来的延期不能造成更早的错过期限；尚未测量的后续参与数据不能成为先前延期的依据；较早的规则也不是对较晚措施的回应。

causal-role-direction.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
causal-role-direction.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

causal-role-direction.target: 措施与结果的对应关系
causal-role-direction.skill: 措施与结果的对应关系
causal-role-direction.q: By accepting a single signed form, the club allows volunteers to avoid requesting a separate signature for every shift. Which benefit is described?
o: Volunteers may work extra shifts without signing any form.
Volunteers need not seek another signature for each shift.
Supervisors supply more signatures for every new volunteer.
Only supervisors may change the shifts a volunteer accepts.

exp.trans: 俱乐部接受一份签好字的表格，从而使志愿者不必每个班次都另外请求签字。好处是省去反复请求签字的手续。
exp.structure: By accepting...说明俱乐部采取的措施；allows的宾语是volunteers；to avoid requesting...说明志愿者由此免于什么行为。separate signature是被省去的逐班次手续。
exp.other: shift 班次；signature 签字；avoid doing 避免做、不必做；single 单份的。
exp.meaning: 使某人免于寻找或请求某物，不等于给他更多该物。先列措施、受益主体、被省去的行为和结果，再检查选项有没有改成增加数量或扩大资格。
exp.rest: 原文仍有一份已签字表格，不能说完全无须签字或允许多工作班次；也未说主管供应更多签字；变更班次的权限没有提及。

causal-role-direction.q: After exercise classes began, staff took fewer sick days. Researchers wondered whether a simultaneous change in leave policy explained the drop, so they compared units where the policy had not changed. Why?
o: To prove that classes alone caused the drop.
To measure how much the staff enjoyed exercise.
To show that every unit changed its leave policy.
To test a rival explanation for the sick-day decline.

exp.trans: 健身课后员工病假减少，研究者怀疑同期请假制度变化也可能造成下降，于是检查制度未改变的部门。
exp.structure: wondered whether提出备选解释；so引出检验该解释的方法。
exp.other: rival explanation竞争性解释；leave policy请假制度。
exp.meaning: 对照政策未变的单位是检验替代原因，不是自动确证健身课的因果效果。
exp.rest: 不能凭这一比较证明唯一原因，也不是测量满意度或证明各单位都改了政策。

causal-role-direction.q: Students taking optional coding classes scored higher, but they also started with stronger skills. After comparisons among students with equal initial ability, the score gap disappeared. What follows?
o: The classes must have lowered every student's final score.
Initial skill can be ignored when comparing the groups.
Prior ability may account for the observed association.
All students received identical training outside class.

exp.trans: 选修编程课学生成绩更好，但入学技能也更强；在相同起始技能者之间比较后差距消失。
exp.structure: but提示潜在混杂变量；after comparisons揭示调整后关联消失。
exp.other: confounding混杂；association关联；initial ability起始能力。
exp.meaning: 起始技能可能解释原本观察到的关联，不能直接把关联等同课程的因果效果。
exp.rest: 成绩全部下降、起始能力可忽略和接受相同课外训练都没有依据。

evaluation-vocab.q: Her critique of the campaign's lameness was spot-on: the slogan was vague, the evidence weak, and the call to action easy to ignore. Which reading is best?
o: 她对宣传乏力之处的批评非常准确。
她因为腿脚不便而无法批评这个宣传。
她只是随意夸奖了这个宣传。
她认为宣传证据充分，只是口号太短。

exp.trans: 她对这项宣传乏力、差劲之处的批评非常到位：口号模糊、证据薄弱，而且行动号召很容易被忽视。
exp.structure: Her critique是主语，was是系动词，spot-on是表语；of the campaign's lameness说明批评对象。冒号后给出为什么说“准确”。
exp.other: vague 模糊的；call to action 行动号召；ignore 忽视；evidence 证据。
exp.meaning: critique=批判性评论/分析；lameness在比喻语境中可指乏力、差劲；spot-on=非常准确、说到点子上。
exp.rest: 把lameness机械译成身体跛不合语境；把critique/spot-on反成随意夸奖也不对；认为evidence充分则与weak evidence直接相反。

evaluation-vocab.q: The brochure pleads with readers to donate, but much of it is filled with irrelevant detail. Its most glaring flaw is that it never explains where the money goes. Which paraphrase is accurate?
o: 宣传册恳求捐款却细节跑题，最明显的缺陷是没说资金去向。
宣传册命令读者捐款，丰富的无关细节构成它最大的优点。
宣传册平静陈述捐款事实，全文没有向读者表达请求。
宣传册最关键的证据就是细节，irrelevant表示与主题密切相关。

exp.trans: 宣传册恳求读者捐款，但其中充斥着无关细节；最明显的缺陷是它从未解释资金流向。
exp.structure: The brochure是主语，pleads是谓语；but后much of it is filled...；Its most glaring flaw is that...是系表结构，that从句说明缺陷内容。
exp.other: brochure 宣传册；donate 捐款；where the money goes 资金去向；detail 细节。
exp.meaning: plead=恳求；irrelevant=无关的；glaring flaw=非常明显的缺陷。三者都是评价/语气词，不能只按最熟悉的字面义处理。
exp.rest: pleads是恳求而非命令，也不是平静地不作请求；flaw是缺陷而非优点；irrelevant指无关，不能把它解释为关键且密切相关。

evaluation-vocab.skill: 抽象评价取向与词义边界
evaluation-vocab.q: A help centre rewards agents only for ending calls quickly. An essay notes that callers with complex problems are repeatedly cut off, then says, 'The trouble is what counts as success here.' What is the essay criticising?
o: A rigid ethical code that demands flawless conduct.
The complete absence of any measure of performance.
The equal weight given to speed and careful advice.
A narrow value system that puts speed above service.

exp.trans: 帮助中心只奖励迅速结束通话的工作人员。文章指出复杂问题来电屡遭挂断，随后批评这里把什么当作成功。批评对象是把速度置于服务之上的狭窄评价取向。
exp.structure: 首句only限定奖励依据；第二句essay为notes和says的主语，that从句提供评价造成的具体后果；引语中的what counts as success是名词性从句，指被当作成功的标准。
exp.other: agent工作人员；cut off中断通话；count as被视为；flawless无瑕疵的。
exp.meaning: distorted values批评何种目标被抬高、何种责任被忽视；a rigid moral code说的是道德规范过于严格，不能只因都涉及好坏就当成同义。
exp.rest: “要求道德完美的僵硬准则”错置了批评对象；“完全没有绩效标准”忽略只按速度奖励的明确标准；“速度和认真建议同权”与only及cut off的后果不符。

evaluation-vocab.target: distorted values / 具体评价标准
evaluation-vocab.q: An awards committee praises productions for ticket income while treating honest accounts of costs as an inconvenience. A critic calls this 'distorted values'. Which explanation fits?
o: Financial results are placed above honest conduct.
Ethical rules are enforced with excessive strictness.
Artistic work is no longer judged by any standard.
Every production has deliberately falsified accounts.

exp.trans: 评奖委员会赞赏作品的票房，却把如实交代成本当作麻烦。评论者称之为价值观扭曲，意思是经济结果被置于诚实行事之上。
exp.structure: 首句committee为主语，praises为谓语；while treating...补充与之对照的做法，treat A as B表示把A看作B。第二句critic为calls的主语，this回指前述评价取向。
exp.other: production文艺作品；ticket income票房收入；account账目、说明；inconvenience麻烦。
exp.meaning: 抽象评价必须回到支持它的具体对照：重票房、轻如实报告。它既不是道德过严，也不能证明所有参与者实际造假。
exp.rest: “道德规范执行过严”与不重视诚实的方向相反；“完全没有判断标准”忽略已有的票房标准；“所有作品均故意造假”加入了原文没有确认的全称事实。

evaluation-vocab.q: A factory code replaces automatic closure for a first violation with a written warning. Compared with the old response, the new sanction is:
o: more permanent for every new breach of the code
less severe for an initial breach of the rule
more punitive for any first-time safety mistake
more frequent because all warnings recur weekly

exp.trans: 工厂新守则把首次违规的自动停业改成书面警告。
exp.structure: replaces A with B指替换；for a first violation限定适用情形。
exp.other: sanction制裁；punitive惩罚性的；violation违规。
exp.meaning: 从停业到书面警告体现处罚力度减轻，即less severe / more lenient。
exp.rest: 不是更持久、更严厉，也没有说明警告每周发生。

evaluation-vocab.q: An audit found repeated falsification of equipment logs and called these acts 'malpractices.' In this context, what does the term mean?
o: Improper conduct rather than ordinary work routines.
Harmless professional habits carried out each day.
Authorized training sessions for junior technicians.
Routine storage of the equipment maintenance logs.

exp.trans: 审计发现反复伪造设备记录，并把这些行为称为malpractices。
exp.structure: called these acts将伪造行为称作不当行为；falsification是定义线索。
exp.other: malpractice不当行为；falsification伪造；audit审计。
exp.meaning: 词缀mal-表示不当，与单独的practices日常做法不同。
exp.rest: 无害习惯、获批准培训和普通存档均不是反复伪造记录。
